title: The Holy District and the Prince's Portion

questions.question: When the land is allotted as an inheritance, what must be set apart for the Lord?
options: A holy district of the land, 25,000 cubits long and 20,000 cubits broad
One tenth of all fields and vineyards
The entire city of Jerusalem
A single mountain for sacrifice
questions.correctAnswer: A holy district of the land, 25,000 cubits long and 20,000 cubits broad
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:1 (ESV): "When you allot the land as an inheritance, you shall set apart for the Lord a portion of the land as a holy district, 25,000 cubits long and 20,000 cubits broad; it shall be holy throughout its whole extent."

questions.question: Within this holy district, a designated central square area of 500 by 500 cubits is for what?
options: The sanctuary (the temple)
The prince's palace
A public market
A pasture for the sacrificial sheep
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:2 (ESV): "Of this, a square plot of 500 by 500 cubits shall be for the sanctuary, with fifty cubits for an open space around it."

questions.question: To whom does the holy portion of the land (the first 25,000x10,000 area) belong?
options: The priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who approach the Lord to minister to him
The king of Israel
The tribe of Judah
The poorest of the land
questions.correctAnswer: The priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who approach the Lord to minister to him
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:4 (ESV): "It shall be a holy portion of the land. It shall be for the priests, who minister in the sanctuary and approach the Lord to minister to him, and it shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary."

questions.question: Who gets the adjoining strip of land (another 25,000x10,000 cubits)?
options: The Levites, the ministers of the temple
The prince
The descendants of David
The foreigners living in the land
questions.correctAnswer: The Levites, the ministers of the temple
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:5 (ESV): "Another section, 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits broad, shall be for the Levites who minister at the temple, as their possession for cities to live in."

questions.question: What lands belong to the prince?
options: The land located on both sides (east and west) of the holy district and of the city's property
The very center of the sanctuary
Only the seacoast
There is no prince, only priests have land
questions.correctAnswer: The land located on both sides (east and west) of the holy district and of the city's property
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:7 (ESV): "And what belongs to the prince shall be on both sides of the holy district and the property of the city, alongside the holy district and the property of the city, on the west and on the east..."

questions.question: Why did God decree this specific portion of land for the princes of Israel?
options: So they shall no more oppress His people, but give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes
To ensure they become wealthier than the kings of the surrounding nations
Because they were the best farmers
Because a king needs much land for his chariot armies
questions.correctAnswer: So they shall no more oppress His people, but give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:8 (ESV): "It shall be to him as a property in Israel. And my princes shall no more oppress my people, but they shall let the house of Israel have the land according to their tribes."

questions.question: What command does God give the princes of Israel regarding justice in verse 9?
options: "Put away violence and oppression, and execute justice and righteousness. Cease your evictions of my people."
"Execute all who will not bow to my laws."
"Demand a heavy tax to fund the temple."
"Conquer all the lands from the Nile to the Euphrates."
questions.correctAnswer: "Put away violence and oppression, and execute justice and righteousness. Cease your evictions of my people."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:9 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord God: Enough, O princes of Israel! Put away violence and oppression, and execute justice and righteousness. Cease your evictions of my people, declares the Lord God."

questions.question: What economic standard must the princes enforce?
options: "You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath."
"You shall use gold instead of silver for trade."
"You shall not trade with foreign nations."
"You shall require no interest on any loans whatsoever."
questions.correctAnswer: "You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:10 (ESV): "You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath."

questions.question: What is the required standard offering for wheat and barley mentioned in verse 13?
options: One sixth of an ephah from each homer
One tenth of the crop (a tithe)
The first sheaf of the harvest
Fifty shekels worth of grain
questions.correctAnswer: One sixth of an ephah from each homer
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:13 (ESV): "This is the offering that you shall make: one sixth of an ephah from each homer of wheat, and one sixth of an ephah from each homer of barley,"

questions.question: What is the prince's duty regarding the national offerings at the feasts, the new moons, and the Sabbaths?
options: "It shall be the prince's duty to furnish the burnt offerings, grain offerings, and drink offerings..."
"He must collect the offerings from the people stringently."
"He must offer them with his own hands as priest."
"He is exempt from these, having given his land instead."
questions.correctAnswer: "It shall be the prince's duty to furnish the burnt offerings, grain offerings, and drink offerings..."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:17 (ESV): "It shall be the prince's duty to furnish the burnt offerings, grain offerings, and drink offerings, at the feasts, the new moons, and the Sabbaths, all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel..."

questions.question: What is the purpose of the prince furnishing these offerings?
options: To make atonement for the house of Israel
To show the surrounding nations his wealth
To feed the priests
To ensure rains in their season
questions.correctAnswer: To make atonement for the house of Israel
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:17 (ESV): "...he shall provide the sin offerings, grain offerings, burnt offerings, and peace offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel."

questions.question: In the first month, on the first day of the month, what shall be done to purify the sanctuary?
options: You shall take a bull from the herd without blemish, and purify the sanctuary... putting blood on the doorposts of the temple, the corners of the altar ledge, and the gateway of the inner court
All the priests must fast for three days
The temple must be washed entirely with water from the Kidron
A scapegoat is released into the wilderness
questions.correctAnswer: You shall take a bull from the herd without blemish, and purify the sanctuary... putting blood on the doorposts of the temple, the corners of the altar ledge, and the gateway of the inner court
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:18-19 (ESV): "...take a bull from the herd without blemish, and purify the sanctuary. The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the doorposts of the temple, the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and the posts of the gate of the inner court."

questions.question: On the fourteenth day of the first month, what feast begins and lasts for seven days?
options: The Passover
The Feast of Weeks (Pentecost)
The Feast of Booths (Tabernacles)
The Feast of Trumpets
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:21 (ESV): "In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall celebrate the Feast of the Passover, and for seven days unleavened bread shall be eaten."

questions.question: What must the prince provide for himself and all the people of the land on the day of the Passover?
options: A bull for a sin offering
A lamb without blemish
Two turtledoves
A gold coin for the sanctuary treasury
questions.correctAnswer: A bull for a sin offering
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:22 (ESV): "On that day the prince shall provide for himself and all the people of the land a bull for a sin offering."

questions.question: In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month (which corresponds to the Feast of Booths), how long is the prince to make the same provision for sin offerings, burnt offerings, grain offerings, and oil?
options: Seven days
One day
Fourteen days
Forty days
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:25 (ESV): "In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month and for the seven days of the feast, he shall make the same provision for sin offerings, burnt offerings, and grain offerings, and for the oil."

key_verse_text: "Thus says the Lord God: Enough, O princes of Israel! Put away violence and oppression, and execute justice and righteousness. Cease your evictions of my people, declares the Lord God."
